map.水位与水头计算 使用指南: Water Level and Head Calculation — User Guide
map.输入测压管水头、流速与高程，依据伯努利方程分解位置水头、压力水头与流速水头并求总: Enter piezometer head, velocity and elevation to decompose elevation head, pressure head and velocity head via the Bernoulli equation and find the total head, for pipeline pressure-point analysis, pump suction head and energy-loss teaching demos.
map.总水头 H总 = z + p ÷ (ρg) + v² ÷ (2g)，三项依次为位: Total head H_total = z + p ÷ (ρg) + v² ÷ (2g); the three terms are elevation head z, pressure head p/(ρg) and velocity head v²/(2g)
map.按伯努利方程分解测压点能量：位置水头 z 由高程确定，压力水头为相对压强除以重度: Decompose energy at a pressure point with the Bernoulli equation: elevation head z is set by elevation, pressure head is relative pressure divided by specific weight ρg, and velocity head is the kinetic term v²/(2g); their sum is the total head. A drop in total head along the flow is head loss, usable for pipeline pressure-point energy analysis, pump suction calculations and energy-loss teaching demos.
: elevation head 5 m, pressure head 2 m, velocity head 0.3 m → total head = 7.3 m, decreasing along the flow.
map.：上下游总水头差即装置扬程，含沿程局部损失，泵需补足。: : the total-head difference between upstream and downstream is the system head, including pipe and local losses, which the pump must supply.
map.三类水头？: What are the three types of head?
map.位置（高程）、压强（p/ρg）、流速（v²/2g），和为总水头。: Elevation (z), pressure (p/ρg) and velocity (v²/2g) heads; their sum is the total head.
map.沿流线总水头守恒（理想），实际减损失，是管网计算基础。: Along a streamline the total head is conserved ideally, reduced by losses in practice—the basis of pipeline-network calculations.
